t: The Moselle dual-lever mono mixer kitchen tap in chrome offers precise water flow and temperature control, ideal for busy kitchen environments. This robust tap features a functional swivel spout, providing flexibility for single or double sinks, alongside 1/4 turn ceramic disc valves for reliable operation. A built-in Neoperl aerator helps to regulate water consumption, and the anti-limescale spout rubs clean for lasting performance. Constructed from brass and designed for deck mounting, it is suitable for high pressure and gravity-fed systems.
